evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: Large language model (LLM)-based metrics are now the best-correlated with radiologist judgment, yet they output a single opaque score that neither a clinician nor a model builder can easily interpret or audit.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: We introduce RadMatch, a multi-stage, LLM-based metric that decomposes report comparison into a structured finding-level matching with significance-aware scoring and error characterization across seven clinical attribute dimensions (status, location, severity, morphology, certainty, longitudinal comparison, and measurement).

declaredVenue: Accepted to ECCV 2026 Workshop on Medical Foundation Models and Benchmarks
